claim_boundary: Train-only quality filtering and multiplicity weighting of reconstructed complete antibody systems. This policy does not materialize contact labels, define a train/development split, authorize training, or report model performance.

deduplication.sequence_duplicates: Retain distinct physical systems but group and downweight them; the later split must keep every exact antibody-antigen sequence pair in one partition.

multiplicity_weight.final_normalization: divide clipped weights by their arithmetic mean so the final mean is one
multiplicity_weight.interface_cluster_signature: sorted unique PINDER interface cluster IDs across all antibody-antigen support edges of the physical system

quality_filter.applies_to: every antibody-antigen support edge; the H-L assembly-support edge is not an antibody-antigen label source and is not included
